item.title: Assist Reminder (1.0)
item.description:
Version: 1.0
Author: sparthir
Category: Unit Frames Character Fellowship Target
Updated: 2026-08-29 08:25 UTC
Downloads: 276
File: AssistReminder.zip (8.4 KB)

Assist Reminder watches your fellowship while you are the leader and pops up a reminder window if no assist target has been set.

Coordinated fellowship play works best when everyone attacks the same foe. The assist target is how a leader tells the fellowship which enemy to focus on but it is easy to forget to set one when the fight starts. This plugin detects when leadership is yours the fellowship has 2 members and no assist target is set then reminds you so the group focuses its damage appropriately.


Checks the party state every 1 second.

Version: 1.0
Author: Exogenesis
Category: Unit Frames Character Fellowship Target
Updated: 2024-03-14 22:17 UTC
Downloads: 11,871
File: ExoPlugins.zip (265.3 KB)

Welcome to the Acumen plugin

This plugin has been designed to replace the default vitals frame with something significantly more legible.

This new vitals frame can be moved the same way the default frame is moved. For most users this is done via the following keyboard shortcut: "CTRL".

The more discerning users can take advantage of some of the string replacement options this plugins offers. Currently the name field supports:

l = Replaced with player/target level
n = Replaced with player/target name
